featuresPage.title: Features
featuresPage.subtitle: Discover everything Bookmark Scout has to offer

instantSearch.title: Instant Search
instantSearch.description: Quickly find any bookmark with our lightning-fast search. Features debounced input for performance and folder filtering to narrow down results.

dragAndDrop.title: Drag & Drop Organization
dragAndDrop.description: Reorganize your bookmarks with intuitive drag-and-drop. Move bookmarks between folders or reorder within a folder with ease.

quickAdd.title: Quick Add
quickAdd.description: Save the current tab to any folder with just one click. No more navigating through nested menus - just pick a folder and done!

sidePanel.title: Side Panel
sidePanel.description: Access your bookmarks directly from Chrome's side panel without leaving your current page. Perfect for research and reference work.

bookmarksManager.title: Full Bookmarks Manager
bookmarksManager.description: Replace Chrome's default bookmarks page with a custom manager that includes a folder tree, breadcrumbs, a table-based bookmark view, and a right-side tools panel.

optionsPage.title: Options Page
optionsPage.description: Configure appearance, search, behavior, AI providers, AI tools, maintenance tools, metadata, security, analytics, data, and context-menu behavior.

darkMode.title: Beautiful Dark Mode
darkMode.description: A stunning dark theme that's easy on the eyes. Features smooth transitions and carefully chosen colors for optimal readability.

expandCollapse.title: Expand/Collapse All
expandCollapse.description: Quickly expand or collapse all nested folders with a single click. Great for getting an overview or focusing on specific sections.

createFolders.title: Create Folders
createFolders.description: Create new bookmark folders directly from the popup. Keep your bookmarks organized without opening the bookmark manager.

deleteItems.title: Delete Items
deleteItems.description: Remove unwanted bookmarks and folders with confirmation dialogs to prevent accidental deletions.

maintenanceTools.title: Maintenance Tools
maintenanceTools.description: Clean duplicate bookmarks, remove tracking parameters, scan dead links, fetch metadata, inspect privacy-sensitive URLs, and collect bookmark statistics.

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export bookmarks as HTML, JSON, Markdown, or CSV. Import existing bookmark files from HTML or JSON.

aiTools.title: AI Tools
aiTools.description: Use opt-in AI providers for bookmark recommendations, LLM context packing, tag suggestions, summaries, and folder reorganization plans.

contextMenu.title: Context Menu Save
contextMenu.description: Save links from the browser right-click menu into recent folders or the default Bookmarks Bar.

settingsSync.title: Settings Sync
settingsSync.description: Store extension preferences through chrome.storage.sync so settings can follow your browser account where supported.

roadmap.title: Current Focus
roadmap.shortcuts: Keyboard Shortcuts — Navigate and act with hotkeys
roadmap.persistentTags: Persistent Tags — Store and manage custom tags beyond AI-generated suggestions
roadmap.tests: Automated Tests — Add dedicated unit and integration coverage for bookmark workflows
roadmap.storeDistribution: Store Distribution — Polish Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, and Edge Add-ons listings
